metrics.name: Total Invested AUM
metrics.description: Total invested corpus across FundsIndia platform funds.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_invested), 0) AS value FROM fund_platform_stats
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(month AS VARCHAR) AS date, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'redemption' THEN -total_amount ELSE total_amount END), 0) AS value FROM monthly_txn_summary GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Net Monthly Inflow
metrics.description: Successful purchases minus redemptions by month.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'redemption' THEN -total_amount ELSE total_amount END), 0) AS value FROM monthly_txn_summary
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(month AS VARCHAR) AS date, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'redemption' THEN -total_amount ELSE total_amount END), 0) AS value FROM monthly_txn_summary GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Active SIPs
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(active_sip_count), 0) AS value FROM fund_platform_stats
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(month AS VARCHAR) AS date, COALESCE(SUM(new_sips - cancelled_sips) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0) AS value FROM monthly_platform_kpis ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: New SIPs
metrics.description: New SIPs created during the dataset period.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(new_sips), 0) AS value FROM monthly_platform_kpis
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(month AS VARCHAR) AS date, new_sips AS value FROM monthly_platform_kpis ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: SIP Cancellation Rate
metrics.description: Cancelled SIPs as a percentage of newly created SIPs.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cancelled_sips) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(new_sips), 0), 0) AS value FROM monthly_platform_kpis
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(month AS VARCHAR) AS date, COALESCE(cancelled_sips * 100.0 / NULLIF(new_sips, 0), 0) AS value FROM monthly_platform_kpis ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Estimated Monthly Commission
metrics.description: Estimated monthly trailing commission across AMCs.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(est_monthly_commission), 0) AS value FROM amc_performance
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(month AS VARCHAR) AS date, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount) * 0.008 / 12, 0) AS value FROM monthly_txn_summary WHERE txn_type <> 'redemption' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: First Investment Rate
metrics.description: Share of signups who completed their first investment.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(first_invested) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(signups), 0), 0) AS value FROM investor_funnel
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(cohort_month AS VARCHAR) AS date, COALESCE(SUM(first_invested) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(signups), 0), 0) AS value FROM investor_funnel GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: KYC Completion Rate
metrics.description: Share of signups whose KYC status is verified.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE kyc_status = 'verified') * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS value FROM raw_investors WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2024-06-01'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(strftime(signup_date::DATE, '%Y-%m') || '-01' AS VARCHAR) AS date, COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE kyc_status = 'verified') * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS value FROM raw_investors WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2024-06-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: FI Select AUM Share
metrics.description: Share of invested AUM in curated FI Select funds.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_fi_select THEN total_invested ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_invested), 0), 0) AS value FROM fund_platform_stats
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(txn_date AS VARCHAR) AS date, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_fi_select THEN amount_inr ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(amount_inr), 0), 0) AS value FROM transactions_full WHERE status = 'success' AND txn_type <> 'redemption' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Campaign Conversion Rate
metrics.description: Share of delivered CRM messages that converted.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(converted) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(delivered), 0), 0) AS value FROM campaign_performance
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(month AS VARCHAR) AS date, COALESCE(SUM(converted) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(delivered), 0), 0) AS value FROM campaign_performance GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: B30 Active SIP Book
metrics.description: Monthly active SIP book from B30 cities.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(active_sip_book_inr), 0) AS value FROM city_tier_kpis WHERE city_tier = 'b30'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(month AS VARCHAR) AS date, COALESCE(SUM(active_sip_book_inr), 0) AS value FROM city_tier_kpis WHERE city_tier = 'b30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Goal On-Track Rate
metrics.description: Share of goal plans currently on track.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(on_track) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_goals), 0), 0) AS value FROM goal_achievement
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(strftime(created_date::DATE, '%Y-%m') || '-01' AS VARCHAR) AS date, COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on_track') * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS value FROM raw_goals GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
